entries.text: Wasting my time, I see. Get lost!
entries.source_text: Wasting my time, I see. Get lost!

entries.text: Oh, you want candy. Sorry, I don't have any. Goodbye.
entries.source_text: Oh, you want candy. Sorry, I don't have any. Goodbye.

entries.text: Oh, a Vault. I'm sure that is very nice. Maybe you can talk to one# of my superiors about that. I'm kinda busy right now.
entries.source_text:
Oh, a Vault. I'm sure that is very nice. Maybe you can talk to one
# of my superiors about that. I'm kinda busy right now.

entries.text: It is very dangerous here. Big, bad monsters took over this place.# We are trying to save what we can before they come back.
entries.source_text:
It is very dangerous here. Big, bad monsters took over this place.
# We are trying to save what we can before they come back.

entries.text: Okay. Suit yourself. When they get back here, you can be their dinner.
entries.source_text: Okay. Suit yourself. When they get back here, you can be their dinner.

entries.text: You can try. I'm not sure you will get very far, though. Good luck to you.
entries.source_text: You can try. I'm not sure you will get very far, though. Good luck to you.

entries.text: Uh oh is right. They are nasty. We are trying to make them understand# that people and monsters can live together.
entries.source_text:
Uh oh is right. They are nasty. We are trying to make them understand
# that people and monsters can live together.

entries.text: Just tell me who you are before I blow off your head.
entries.source_text: Just tell me who you are before I blow off your head.

entries.text: I'm a Follower. Where did everyone go?
entries.source_text: I'm a Follower. Where did everyone go?

entries.text: I'm one of you. Now let me pass.
entries.source_text: I'm one of you. Now let me pass.

entries.text: Come with me. I'll show you where everyone else went.
entries.source_text: Come with me. I'll show you where everyone else went.

entries.text: Of course! Who else would I be?
entries.source_text: Of course! Who else would I be?

entries.text: No, I am a Children member.
entries.source_text: No, I am a Children member.

entries.text: Silly me. I mistook you for someone else. Come with me. I'll show# you the way.
entries.source_text:
Silly me. I mistook you for someone else. Come with me. I'll show
# you the way.

entries.text: I don't remember you. What's the name?
entries.source_text: I don't remember you. What's the name?

entries.text: . How could you forget about me?
entries.source_text: . How could you forget about me?

entries.text: I'm sorry. I still don't remember you. Maybe someone else may remember# who you are.
entries.source_text:
I'm sorry. I still don't remember you. Maybe someone else may remember
# who you are.

entries.text: Yes, I remember you. We were told to look for you. Vengeance shall be mine!
entries.source_text: Yes, I remember you. We were told to look for you. Vengeance shall be mine!

entries.text: You are in my patrol area. It is my business. Talk or die!
entries.source_text: You are in my patrol area. It is my business. Talk or die!

entries.text: Good. Just making sure for your headstone.
entries.source_text: Good. Just making sure for your headstone.

entries.text: Then I don't have to let you live. Good night.
entries.source_text: Then I don't have to let you live. Good night.

entries.text: I'm a Follower. Where did everyone go?
entries.source_text: I'm a Follower. Where did everyone go?

entries.text: I'm one of you. Now let me pass.
entries.source_text: I'm one of you. Now let me pass.

entries.text: Deathslayer, eh? You look more like worm bait to me.
entries.source_text: Deathslayer, eh? You look more like worm bait to me.

entries.text: If you are a friend, then prove it.
entries.source_text: If you are a friend, then prove it.

entries.text: I helped kill those mutant things.
entries.source_text: I helped kill those mutant things.

entries.text: Really? I think my boss would like to hear more about that.# Go look for Orfeo. He'll be able to reward you for your help.
entries.source_text:
Really? I think my boss would like to hear more about that.
# Go look for Orfeo. He'll be able to reward you for your help.

entries.text: For someone who comes in peace, you do an awful lot of killing.# But those Rippers were causing quite a bit of trouble. Orfeo can reward your# for your aid.
entries.source_text:
For someone who comes in peace, you do an awful lot of killing.
# But those Rippers were causing quite a bit of trouble. Orfeo can reward your
# for your aid.

entries.text: You kill harmless creatures which are the end result of man's# destructive nature and then claim peace?
entries.source_text:
You kill harmless creatures which are the end result of man's
# destructive nature and then claim peace?

entries.text: I'm sorry. They were ugly, so I shot them.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry. They were ugly, so I shot them.

entries.text: They were hurting people all over the place.
entries.source_text: They were hurting people all over the place.

entries.text: Now I'm going to kill you.
entries.source_text: Now I'm going to kill you.

entries.text: I still let you live. I think I better take you in to have you# cleansed of these thoughts of destruction.
entries.source_text:
I still let you live. I think I better take you in to have you
# cleansed of these thoughts of destruction.

entries.text: Funny. I thought I saw some of them out in the street trying to# clean up the gangs.
entries.source_text:
Funny. I thought I saw some of them out in the street trying to
# clean up the gangs.

entries.text: Those losers are now no more.
entries.source_text: Those losers are now no more.

entries.text: That's a good thing. Well, goodbye.
entries.source_text: That's a good thing. Well, goodbye.

entries.text: And now, you won't be either.
entries.source_text: And now, you won't be either.

entries.text: That's where I know you from. It's payback time!
entries.source_text: That's where I know you from. It's payback time!

entries.text: It's you again. I thought you would have learned by now. Too little,# too late, I guess.
entries.source_text:
It's you again. I thought you would have learned by now. Too little,
# too late, I guess.

entries.text: 你面前是一位警觉的哨兵。
entries.source_text: 你面前是一位警觉的哨兵。

entries.text: 我我？你赶紧给我滚！这里是大教堂教徒的私有地界。
entries.source_text: 我我？你赶紧给我滚！这里是大教堂教徒的私有地界。

entries.text: 好嘛。你是我遇见的最白痴的猪头，我能帮你做什么？
entries.source_text: 好嘛。你是我遇见的最白痴的猪头，我能帮你做什么？

entries.text: 算了，你赶紧走，别逼我杀了你。
entries.source_text: 算了，你赶紧走，别逼我杀了你。

entries.text: 你还能帮我？搞笑。你有什么要问的？
entries.source_text: 你还能帮我？搞笑。你有什么要问的？

entries.text: 避烂？避烂？什么是他妈的避烂啊？
entries.source_text: 避烂？避烂？什么是他妈的避烂啊？

entries.text: 哦，你想吃糖糖？抱歉，我没有。再见！
entries.source_text: 哦，你想吃糖糖？抱歉，我没有。再见！

entries.text: “避难所”吧！这里是个好地方，你可以问问我的上司，我现在很忙。
entries.source_text: “避难所”吧！这里是个好地方，你可以问问我的上司，我现在很忙。

entries.text: 这里很恐怖哦！大大的坏坏的怪物住在这里哦！我们要在它们回来前拿宝贝哦！
entries.source_text: 这里很恐怖哦！大大的坏坏的怪物住在这里哦！我们要在它们回来前拿宝贝哦！

entries.text: 随你，它们回来就会把你吃了的。
entries.source_text: 随你，它们回来就会把你吃了的。

entries.text: 你可以试试，我觉得你撑不了多久，好运！
entries.source_text: 你可以试试，我觉得你撑不了多久，好运！

entries.text: 呃，对啊。它们很混蛋的。我们一直想让它们明白怪物和人是可以和平相处的。
entries.source_text: 呃，对啊。它们很混蛋的。我们一直想让它们明白怪物和人是可以和平相处的。

entries.text: 赶紧说你是谁，不然我一枪把你脑袋轰了。
entries.source_text: 赶紧说你是谁，不然我一枪把你脑袋轰了。

entries.text: 我是末世论者的信徒，人都去哪里了？
entries.source_text: 我是末世论者的信徒，人都去哪里了？

entries.text: 我是你们的一员，让我过去。
entries.source_text: 我是你们的一员，让我过去。

entries.text: 跟我来，我带你去其他人的所在。
entries.source_text: 跟我来，我带你去其他人的所在。

entries.text: 我真是糊涂，把你误认为其它人了，跟我来，我给你带路。
entries.source_text: 我真是糊涂，把你误认为其它人了，跟我来，我给你带路。

entries.text: 我记不起来了，你叫什么？
entries.source_text: 我记不起来了，你叫什么？

entries.text: 对不起，我还是记不起你，也许其它人会认得你。
entries.source_text: 对不起，我还是记不起你，也许其它人会认得你。

entries.text: 对了，想起来了，我们一直在找你！我今天就毙了你！
entries.source_text: 对了，想起来了，我们一直在找你！我今天就毙了你！

entries.text: 你在我的巡逻区，这就关我的事！说清楚，要么死！
entries.source_text: 你在我的巡逻区，这就关我的事！说清楚，要么死！

entries.text: 很好，你的墓碑上的名字不会刻错了。
entries.source_text: 很好，你的墓碑上的名字不会刻错了。

entries.text: 我是末世论者。其他人呢？
entries.source_text: 我是末世论者。其他人呢？

entries.text: 我是你们的一员，让我过去。
entries.source_text: 我是你们的一员，让我过去。

entries.text: 死神，哈？在我眼里你是屎！
entries.source_text: 死神，哈？在我眼里你是屎！

entries.text: 我帮你们杀过末世论者。
entries.source_text: 我帮你们杀过末世论者。

entries.text: 是吗？我的老板也许可以和你进一步谈谈，去找奥佛吧，他也许会给你些奖赏。
entries.source_text: 是吗？我的老板也许可以和你进一步谈谈，去找奥佛吧，他也许会给你些奖赏。

entries.text: 你沾了这么多人的血很可怕，但那些电锯党恶棍罪恶滔天，奥佛会表彰你的。
entries.source_text: 你沾了这么多人的血很可怕，但那些电锯党恶棍罪恶滔天，奥佛会表彰你的。

entries.text: 这些无害的怪物本来就是人类毁灭本性的牺牲品，你却以杀戮它们取乐？
entries.source_text: 这些无害的怪物本来就是人类毁灭本性的牺牲品，你却以杀戮它们取乐？

entries.text: 对不起，它们太丑了，所以我灭了不少。
entries.source_text: 对不起，它们太丑了，所以我灭了不少。

entries.text: 我今天就不杀你了。我希望你以后能净化你的毁灭思想。
entries.source_text: 我今天就不杀你了。我希望你以后能净化你的毁灭思想。

entries.text: 有趣，我记得有一些人在街头想扫灭帮派。
entries.source_text: 有趣，我记得有一些人在街头想扫灭帮派。

entries.text: 又是你，我以为你会长点记性，没想到你偏不见棺材不落泪。
entries.source_text: 又是你，我以为你会长点记性，没想到你偏不见棺材不落泪。
